channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lawrence Frank | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lawrence Frank from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Bradley Beal on wearing No. 3:

“It’s no disrespect to Chris. Chris and I are amazing friends…I asked the team if 3 is available, they talked about it, [Lawrence Frank] talked about it. They came back and said we’ll do it.”

Bradley Beal on Lawrence Frank, Sep 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Listen,I think after making a trade like that, you’ve got to put out a statement like this. This is one of those save-my-ass statements. But I will say, tough luck, man. Very tough luck. You did get your starting center, but if that comes at the heels of a perennial All-Star, unless the Pacers go win a championship, this could be viewed as a top-five worst trade ever. Now, like he said, a little unlucky, but if it does not pan out the right way, this could go bad. And meanwhile, Lawrence Frank looks like a genius. Looks like a complete genius. But sometimes it’s the luck of the draw, and it just happens to go that way.”

Draymond Green on Lawrence Frank, May 12, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Chris Paul on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Chris Paul:

“So,with that dialogue (with the Clippers) and all that, I mean, early in the season, Lawrence Frank sent me an article about how great my leadership was (laughs). An article I had never seen. He texted it to me saying, ‘Man, this is great leadership right here.’So, it was just interesting situation because I was extremely grateful. You saw I was emotional when I absolutely when I went back and I returned because first of all, all the love that the fans showed, but the thing that made me emotional, I knew it was going to be my last year and I was getting to play in front of my family. Right. And that’s what it was all about.”

Chris Paul on Lawrence Frank, Feb 20, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Ty Lue on the relationship between he and Lawrence Frank, specifically as NBA trade season begins:

“We always work close together. Lawrence has been a great partner. Us trying to be on the same page, understanding what we need, what we wanna do. We’ve always been on the same page… He understands the game, he’s been a coach…We’ve always been on the same page as far as the talent you wanna get, who you wanna try to get, the players you wanna try to get. It doesn’t workout all the time. You can’t get the guys you want every single year… It’s a tough business. We always stay locked in, and we’re hand in hand.”

Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank, Dec 14, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Norman Powell on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
“I didn’t know what to think at first. I mean, it’s been a crazy last couple of weeks, just from talking to Lawrence Frank in my exit meeting and what they were telling me.”

Norman Powell on Lawrence Frank, Jul 10, 2025. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Bill Walton on Lawrence Frank, Tyronn Lue, Steve Ballmer
item.description:
Bill Walton:

“The culture he has built, Steve Ballmer, he bought the Clippers when they were a farce and now they are the authorial standard of excellence. You've got Lawrence Frank running the show, Ty Lue coaching it, you've got the players, it is just fantastic. We couldn't be happier, we couldn't be more proud, they've got the new arena coming. Yeah, the future, woah!”

Bill Walton on Lawrence Frank, Tyronn Lue, Steve Ballmer, Aug 20, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
DeMar DeRozan:

“Nothing but respect for Lawrence Frank and the entire Clippers organization. Great peoiple. It definitely was an opportunity that presented itself. I think for me, the Chicago thing just took off by the time they was on their way to my house. It was a situation, I just didn’t… I didn’t pass it up.”

DeMar DeRozan on Lawrence Frank, Mar 9, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank, Mfiondu Kabengele
item.description:
Law Murray:Tyronn Lue on Mfiondu Kabengele trade:

“You gotta ask Lawrence (Frank) what went into it, but we're going to miss Fi...he was a bright spot for our team, always cheering... hopefully it's a chance to go to Sacramento and play and do well there.”

Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank, Mfiondu Kabengele, Mar 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank, Steve Ballmer
item.description:
“My familiarity with the organization, particularly Mr. Ballmer and Lawrence, confirmed this is where I want to be. We have work to do to become champions, but we have the motivation, the tools, and the support to get there. I’m excited to get started.”

Tyronn Lue on Lawrence Frank, Steve Ballmer, Oct 20, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Sindarius Thornwell on Paul George, Lawrence Frank, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
“Lawrence Frank called me and let me know everything before it happened. He said, ‘We got a chance to get Paul George. And if we get Paul George, we know we are going to get Kawhi (Leonard).With us having to bring Paul George in, we are going to have to let you go,’”

Sindarius Thornwell on Paul George, Lawrence Frank, Kawhi Leonard, Jul 16, 2019. Source: The State.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Clippers coach Doc Rivers says.

“I told [president of basketball operations] Lawrence Frank, 'That kid is going to lead the league in scoring one year.'Lawrence looked at me like I was crazy. He said, 'Why would you make that comment?' I said, 'Because he's fearless. He's going to give himself a chance because believes he's the best scorer out here.'”

Doc Rivers on Lawrence Frank, Jan 23, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kenyon Martin on Mike Woodson, Lawrence Frank, John Calipari
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Kenyon Martin on Calipari rumors:

“If its me, I would probably go a different route. I feel like Mike Woodson & Lawrence Frank deserve another shot.”

Kenyon Martin on Mike Woodson, Lawrence Frank, John Calipari, Jan 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: DeAndre Jordan on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Ben Bolch:A joking DeAndre Jordan:

“A wise man once told me, ‘If you’ve got money, you don’t need a degree, and that wise man was Lawrence Frank.’”

DeAndre Jordan on Lawrence Frank, Mar 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Kidd said of the various media reports on their relationship.

“I’ve been focused on the game plan of playing Boston, and so unfortunately I can’t answer that question. “I’ve been reading the reports [Frank is filing], and that’s as far as it’s going.”

Jason Kidd on Lawrence Frank, Dec 11, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Byron Scott on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
“I could easily see maybe Jason getting to the point where he felt Lawrence was over-stepping his bounds.”

Byron Scott on Lawrence Frank, Dec 5, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Byron Scott on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
“I remained very friendly, very cordial with Lawrence. We always spoke at games where we coached against each other,”

Byron Scott on Lawrence Frank, Dec 5, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jay Williams on Jason Kidd, Lawrence Frank
item.description:
dating back to their days when their relationship was as a player and coach.

“I’m speaking totally upon speculation here, butwhen I played training camp there, and I worked out with J-Kidd for a good five or six months, there was always a little bit of friction between [Kidd and Frank]. Not in the regards of, ‘hey, we hate each other,’ but more so in their styles; their approach to the game,”

Jay Williams on Jason Kidd, Lawrence Frank, Dec 4, 2013. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Jay Williams on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
“When you arrived in training camp, Lawrence Frank handed you a book that was about 10 inches thick that was the playbook. I literally felt like an NFL Quarterback with all the plays I had to memorize, and I had a very difficult time doing so. And thenwhile we would be in practice, when Lawrence Frank would call out different plays, J-Kidd would end up running the plays that he felt fit the team, and Lawrence wouldn’t really say anything to him. Now, Jay’s obviously a perennial All-Star, and you can see that, right? So, the fact that [Kidd] had to re-assign Lawrence Frank didn’t surprise me at all because he is going to do the things he wants to do his way,”

Jay Williams on Lawrence Frank, Dec 4, 2013. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Garnett on Frank:

“There's a lot of moving parts around here, and we're all just trying to adjust to it.”

Kevin Garnett on Lawrence Frank, Dec 3, 2013. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Mike Mazzeo:Kidd:

“One of my candidates for assistant coach is Lawrence Frank. The invitation is out there.”

Jason Kidd on Lawrence Frank, Jun 14, 2013. Source: Twitter @MazzESPN.

item.title: Rodney Stuckey on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Vincent Ellis:Stuckey:

“We good. Me and (Frank) are fine. Sometimes you have disagreements with one another. He did what he had to do and I respect that.”

Rodney Stuckey on Lawrence Frank, Jan 29, 2013. Source: Twitter @Vincent_Ellis56.

item.title: Rodney Stuckey on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Stuckey on Lawrence Frank:

“He's straightforward. He pretty much tells it like it is, no matter who you are. That's what I like.”

Rodney Stuckey on Lawrence Frank, Dec 17, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rod Thorn on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
When he was 33, Frank captured the attention of former New Jersey Nets president Rod Thorn, and now he'll get his second chance to be an NBA head coach.

“Lawrence did a great job for us both as an assistant and a head coach,”

Rod Thorn on Lawrence Frank, Jul 31, 2011. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
Ainge on interest in retaining top assistant Lawrence Frank:

“Yes, Lawrence has interest in coming back. Lawrence will have an opportunity to coach, as you know, he’s been a top candidate with a lot of teams this year, in the offseason... for sure runner-up in a couple of places. We want Lawrence back. Lawrence will have options with other teams, too, he’s not under contract, so he has an option to explore all those options.”

Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank, Jun 22, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
However, Ainge said he's not surprised to hear Frank's name come up as a potential head coaching candidate.

“He's a good coach, but Lawrence is committed 100 percent to our quest to win a championship this year,”

Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank, Mar 24, 2011. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
But the Celtics have not been approached by Tennessee about conversations with Frank, a former Tennessee assistant who has never run a program on the collegiate level.

“All I know is that Lawrence is under contract with us for the rest of the season,”

Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank, Mar 23, 2011. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank
item.description:
“Because I think that Doc (Rivers) really knows our defense, and I think Lawrence Frank is a good coach, and I think our players know how important defense is to our winning,”

Danny Ainge on Lawrence Frank, Nov 5, 2010. Source: Boston Herald.
